settings.dangerZoneLead: Log out removes this account's data from this device (chats, keys, and MLS data). The app will restart.
settings.logoutModalSubtitle: Logout will remove this account's data from this device (chats, keys, and MLS data). The app will restart. You can create a new account or log in with a different key after that.

settings.relaysLead: Relays power your Kind 0 profile, direct messages, and squad channels. Defaults ship with the app; add your own {wss} endpoints when needed.

settings.relayCertUnavailable: No certificate could be retrieved for this relay.

settings.devBuildNote: The in-app updater is disabled in dev builds. Use a release build to check for and install published updates.
settings.enabledChainsHint: Enable chains you use. At least one must stay on. Affects Send, balances, and the DM wallet sidebar.
settings.trackedTokensHint: Tracked assets appear in Send and in the DM wallet sidebar (per network).
settings.noExtraTokensYet: No extra tokens yet. Native ETH balances still show when RPCs are available.
settings.rpcEndpointsHint: Choose which JSON-RPC endpoint Pacto uses for balances, reads, and on-chain actions on each network.
settings.addRpcHint: from a provider below, then paste it under Add RPC.
settings.defaultRpcHint: Includes your personal RPCs and curated public endpoints for this network.
settings.rpcProvidersHint: These providers offer free subscriptions that have high enough limits for basic squad on-chain activities.
settings.externalWalletTitle: Using this address in an external wallet
settings.externalWalletParagraph1: If you want to use the same key pair outside Pacto, import your private key into a well-established wallet app (MetaMask, Rabby, etc.). Export one key at a time from the account list above.
settings.externalWalletParagraph2: Pacto is built primarily for governance with an in-app wallet for squad operations—not for browsing arbitrary DeFi or unreviewed smart contracts. If you need that kind of power-user activity, a dedicated external wallet is a better fit; Pacto is not designed to be your everyday wallet across the whole ecosystem.
